remarks: Whether you're searching for your next home or a smart investment opportunity, this ranch-style condo in Norwalk is a fantastic find! Move-in ready and thoughtfully designed for comfort and convenience, this home features an inviting open floor plan filled with natural light. The stylish kitchen boasts granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and ample storage-making meal preparation a breeze. This charming condo offers two spacious bedrooms and a full bathroom, perfectly suited for any lifestyle. Enjoy the ease of one-level living, complemented by a private deck accessible through sliding doors in the dining area-ideal for morning coffee or evening relaxation.Beyond the home itself, the community provides exceptional amenities, including a sparkling pool, a state-of-the-art pickle-ball court, a dog park, and breathtaking water views. Conveniently located near a variety of excellent restaurants and shops, with quick access to Route 7 and Route 15, this property offers unbeatable convenience for commuters. Don't miss this incredible opportunity-schedule your private tour today
